description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryHelpers enum with static helper methods for handling gateway discovery information such as service host, port, SSH target, and URL generation.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Returns a trimmed, non-empty host string or nil.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Returns a tuple of host and port if the host is resolved and the port is valid.

methods.name: sshTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string using hostname and SSH port.

methods.name: directUrl
methods.description: Generates a secure WebSocket URL based on service host and port.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL scheme (ws or wss) with host and port, based on security considerations.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks whether a hostname refers to a loopback address.
